San Marzano tomatoes
Fresh mozzarella
Fresh basil
Olive oil
Salt", Steps = "1. Preheat oven to 475°F.

3. Spread crushed tomatoes evenly.
4. Tear mozzarella and distribute over sauce.
5. Bake for 10-12 minutes until crust is golden.
6. Top with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil." },
        new Recipe { Id = 2, Title = "Spaghetti Carbonara", Category = "Italian", Ingredients = "Spaghetti
Guanciale or pancetta
Eggs
Pecorino Romano
Black pepper", Steps = "1. Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
2. Fry guanciale until crispy.
3. Whisk eggs with grated pecorino and pepper.
4. Toss hot pasta with guanciale off heat.
5. Add egg mixture and toss quickly to coat.
6. Serve immediately with extra pecorino." },
        new Recipe { Id = 3, Title = "Chicken Tikka Masala", Category = "Indian", Ingredients = "Chicken breast
Yogurt
Garam masala
Turmeric
Tomato sauce
Heavy cream
Garlic
Ginger", Steps = "1. Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 2 hours.

5. Stir in cream and garam masala.

        new Recipe { Id = 4, Title = "Vegetable Pad Thai", Category = "Thai", Ingredients = "Rice noodles
Tofu
Bean sprouts
Peanuts
Lime
Tamarind paste
Fish sauce
Sugar
Garlic", Steps = "1. Soak rice noodles in warm water 30 minutes.

        new Recipe { Id = 5, Title = "Beef Tacos", Category = "Mexican", Ingredients = "Ground beef
Taco seasoning
Corn tortillas
Lettuce
Tomato
Cheddar cheese
Sour cream
Salsa", Steps = "1. Brown ground beef in a skillet.
2. Add taco seasoning and water, simmer 5 minutes.
3. Warm tortillas in a dry pan.
4. Dice tomato and shred lettuce.
5. Assemble tacos with meat and toppings.
6. Serve with salsa and sour cream." },
        new Recipe { Id = 6, Title = "Guacamole", Category = "Mexican", Ingredients = "Avocados
Lime juice
Red onion
Cilantro
Jalapeño
Tomato
Salt", Steps = "1. Halve avocados and remove pits.
2. Mash avocado to desired consistency.
3. Finely dice onion, jalapeño, and tomato.
4. Mix all ingredients together.
5. Season with salt and lime juice.
6. Serve immediately with tortilla chips." },
        new Recipe { Id = 7, Title = "Miso Soup", Category = "Japanese", Ingredients = "Dashi stock
White miso paste
Tofu
Wakame seaweed
Green onions", Steps = "1. Bring dashi stock to a simmer.
2. Rehydrate wakame in water.
3. Cut tofu into small cubes.
4. Dissolve miso paste into the broth (do not boil).
5. Add tofu and wakame.
6. Garnish with sliced green onions." },
        new Recipe { Id = 8, Title = "Chocolate Chip Cookies", Category = "Desserts", Ingredients = "Butter
Sugar
Brown sugar
Eggs
Vanilla
Flour
Baking soda
Salt
Chocolate chips", Steps = "1. Cream butter with both sugars until fluffy.

3. Mix flour, baking soda, and salt separately.
4. Combine wet and dry ingredients.
5. Fold in chocolate chips.
6. Bake at 375°F for 9-11 minutes." },
    };

    private static int _nextId = 9;

    public static IReadOnlyList<Recipe> GetAll() => _recipes.AsReadOnly();

    public static IReadOnlyList<Recipe> GetByCategory(string category) =>
        _recipes.Where(r => r.Category.Equals(category, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();

    public static Recipe? GetById(int id) => _recipes.FirstOrDefault(r => r.Id == id);

    public static IReadOnlyList<string> GetCategories() =>
        _recipes.Select(r => r.Category).Distinct().ToList();

    public static void Add(RecipeSubmission submission)
    {
        _recipes.Add(new Recipe
        {
            Id = _nextId++,
            Title = submission.Title,
            Category = submission.Category,
            Ingredients = submission.Ingredients,
            Steps = submission.Steps
        });
    }

    public static void AddRating(int recipeId, int stars)
    {
        var recipe = GetById(recipeId);
        if (recipe is not null && stars >= 1 && stars <= 5)
        {
            recipe.TotalRatingPoints += stars;
            recipe.RatingCount++;
        }
    }
}

data.content:
The project is ready. Here's a summary:

**Project:** `RecipeCommunity` — Blazor Web App with per-component Interactive Server mode

**Architecture:**
- **Static SSR** (default): Homepage, category listing, recipe detail pages — fast, no WebSocket needed
- **Interactive Server** (opt-in): Star rating widget and Submit Recipe form only

**Pages created:**
| Route | File | Render Mode |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `/` | `Home.razor` | Static SSR |
| `/recipes/{category}` | `CategoryPage.razor` | Static SSR |
| `/recipe/{id}` | `RecipePage.razor` | Static SSR |
| `/submit` | `SubmitRecipe.razor` | Interactive Server |
| (component) | `StarRating.razor` | Interactive Server |

**Key design decisions:**
- `--all-interactive false` keeps the default to static SSR; only the rating widget and form opt in via `@rendermode InteractiveServer`
- In-memory `RecipeStore` serves as a simple data layer with seed recipes across 6 categories
- Form uses `DataAnnotationsValidator` for title/category/ingredients/steps validation

Run with: `cd RecipeCommunity && dotnet run`
